skill.name: project-operator
skill.description: Operates and debugs the local stack (API/worker/frontend); focuses on observability, logs, and safe automation.
skill.summary: Guides safe local stack operations with logs, status checks, and clear rollback planning.
skill.author: ACSKamloops

security_audit.summary: No static findings were reported for this prompt-only skill. Review of SKILL.md found operational safety guidance and no prompt-injection language, executable code, network behavior, or data-exfiltration intent.

content.value_statement: Local development stacks can be hard to debug when logs, services, and config changes are handled out of order. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to inspect evidence first and explain safe operational steps.
actual_capabilities: Guides local API, worker, and frontend troubleshooting with an observability-first approach.
Prioritizes logs and status endpoints before service restarts.
Encourages incremental changes that protect uptime and clarity.
Requests plain-language impact notes and revert paths for config changes.
Prompts stop or cancel strategies for long-running commands.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts, command wrappers, or automation code.
Does not define specific service names, ports, providers, or deployment targets.
Requires project context before recommending exact operational actions.
Does not replace production monitoring, access controls, or incident response processes.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Local Services
use_cases.description: Inspect local API, worker, and frontend behavior by checking logs and status signals before changing services.

use_cases.title: Review Config Changes
use_cases.description: Explain the operational impact of config updates and document a clear rollback path before applying them.

use_cases.title: Plan Safe Automation
use_cases.description: Prepare incremental operational steps with observable checkpoints and stop strategies for long-running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Check Stack Health
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a safe first inspection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-operator to inspect the local API, worker, and frontend health. Start with logs and status endpoints. Summarize findings and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Debug One Failing Service
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused troubleshooting when one service is unhealthy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-operator to debug the failing local service. Read recent logs first, identify likely causes, and suggest the smallest observable fix.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Config Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before changing local configuration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-operator to review this config change. Explain impact in plain language, list risks, and provide a practical revert path.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Long Operation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operational plan for a slow or risky task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-operator to plan this long-running operation. Define checkpoints, observability signals, stop criteria, and a cancel strategy before execution.

output_examples.input: The worker is failing during local development.
output_examples.output: Start by reading the worker logs and checking related status endpoints. Then isolate the smallest change and describe how to reverse it.

output_examples.input: I need to change a local configuration value.
output_examples.output: Explain what the setting affects, verify current behavior, apply the change incrementally, and keep a clear revert path.

output_examples.input: A command may run for several minutes.
output_examples.output: Define the expected progress signals, when to stop, how to cancel safely, and what logs to review during execution.

best_practices: Check logs and status endpoints before restarting local processes.
Make operational changes incrementally and verify each result.
Document config impact and a rollback path before applying changes.
anti_patterns: Restarting services before collecting evidence from logs or health checks.
Changing multiple configuration values without a clear verification point.
Running long commands without stop criteria or a cancel strategy.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code operate and debug a local API, worker, and frontend stack.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides operational guidance and does not include executable automation code.

faq.question: Is this for production incidents?
faq.answer: It is mainly written for local stack operations and should not replace production incident procedures.

faq.question: How does it reduce operational risk?
faq.answer: It promotes evidence gathering, incremental changes, plain-language impact notes, and rollback planning.

faq.question: Can it debug any project stack?
faq.answer: It can guide the workflow, but exact actions depend on the project services, commands, and logs.

faq.question: Why mention long-running commands?
faq.answer: Long operations need progress checks, stop criteria, and cancel strategies to avoid unclear or unsafe changes.
